events.what: 护士带两人进诊室；顾问给 Callie 涂耦合剂、在腹部移动超声探头；房间安静，顾问倒吸一口气；Caius 知道那口气意味着什么；顾问换角度又吸一口气后说 'I'm very sorry, Miss Foster. There's no heartbeat.'
verbatim_anchors: the consultant's sharp intake of breath meant
The consultant tried a different angle. Another breath.
'I'm very sorry, Miss Foster. There's no heartbeat.'

events.what: Callie 点头，想哭却无泪；Caius 握住她的手；顾问说是 missed miscarriage，胎儿在九周停止生长而身体仍以为怀孕，给三个选项（等激素下降自然、用药加速、手术）；Callie 终于哭出来；顾问说不必马上决定；Caius 从护士手里拿了一张传单
verbatim_anchors: Callie nodded. She wanted to cry but there was nothing.
'You've had what's called a missed miscarriage. The foetus stopped growing at nine weeks but your body still thinks you're pregnant.'
Caius took a leaflet from the nurse.

events.what: Callie 低声问 'Why?'；顾问摇头说不知道，通常是胎儿有遗传问题导致不能存活，有时就是会这样发生
verbatim_anchors: 'Why?' Callie whispered.
'I don't know. Usually there's a genetic problem with the foetus which makes it incompatible with life. Sometimes it just happens.'

events.what: 出租车后座沉默回家；Callie 换睡衣蜷在沙发看讲房产中介的真人秀；Caius 打开 Guardian app 读美国又一起校园枪击，滚动被婴儿衣物广告打断；Caius 沏茶并说不是她的错；Caius 援引传单说这种情况很常见，'Ten to twenty per cent of pregnancies. Most are a one-off.'；Callie 怕以后不能有孩子；Caius 说无所谓有没有继承人，'The National Trust can have the lot.'；两人决定'再试'是以后的事，先搬进梦想房子、先粉刷；两人在沙发看 A Knight's Tale，聊 Chaucer、Old English、Queen 是 Freddie Mercury
verbatim_anchors: Ten to twenty per cent of pregnancies. Most are a one-off.
I don't care whether I have an heir. The National Trust can have the lot.
'At some point. But not right now. You need to recover, and we need to move into our dream house first.'
'No, but there's Queen.' / 'Freddie Mercury.'

events.what: Caius 出去取披萨（他不想在 Callie 面前显得太失望，免得她又自责），给妈妈 Bridget 打电话；他说 Callie 得了 missed miscarriage；他说自己刚认识 Callie 时就认定是她，怀孩子虽是意外但本会很好；Bridget 说自己生 Caius 之后也流过产、之后几个月崩溃过；她说 'Time helps'；Caius 说今晚不求婚了，Bridget 说他可以慢慢来
verbatim_anchors: 'Callie's had what they call a missed miscarriage,' Caius said.
'I had a miscarriage after I had you.'
'Time helps.'
'I'm not going to propose tonight.'

events.what: Caius 走到自家巷底时，一辆贴着黑膜车窗的车靠上来，车窗落下是熟人的声音 'Jump in,'；Caius 拒绝并走开（叙述给出 Hampton 身份：前内阁大臣、已故的 Rupert 的父亲、爱操弄 Caius 去查政治上方便的案子）；Hampton 说不想在街上被人听见要谈；Caius 拒绝被利用去搞倒政府的阴谋；Hampton 提议 'How about being the government instead'；Hampton 说后二战秩序就要崩塌、俄罗斯/美国/中国/AI，说要他打给 Hunderby、有一个安全席位；Caius 提到姐姐的悲剧与 special unit、Hampton 利用了那件事；Caius 说 'I've had one of the worst days of my life' 并长段反驳（Hampton 的 Anglo-Norman  paternalistic revival、Mad Max 时间线、风电、气候、'We're all just fucked'）；Hampton 说 'There's always one last hope'；对身边的女人说 Caius 'He'll come around.'
